descriptionFull: The American wigeon ( Mareca americana ), also called a baldpate , is a species of dabbling duck found in North America. Formerly assigned to Anas , this species is classified with the other wigeons in the dabbling duck genus Mareca . It is the New World counterpart of the Eurasian wigeon. Mareca is from the Brazilian-Portuguese word Marréco for a small duck and americana refers to America.
